seo.title: CarGurus: AI predictive intelligence sold to dealers - Dealer Data Insights used by 60% of paying dealers (2026)
seo.meta_description: CarGurus monetizes its dealers with AI predictive intelligence fed by 500M signals per day: Dealer Data Insights used by 60% of paying dealers in 2025.
seo.resume_citable: At its full-year 2025 results (released February 19, 2026), CarGurus quantified its AI monetization strategy: about 500 million first-party shopper signals ingested each day, turned into predictive intelligence and resold to dealers through products such as Dealer Data Insights (used by 60% of global paying dealers) and PriceVantage, with annual revenue of 907.0 million dollars, up 14%, and monetized products expected to grow roughly 15x in 2026.

faq.q: How does CarGurus use AI to monetize dealers?
faq.a: CarGurus captures about 500 million first-party shopper signals per day across its shopping surfaces, including the CG Discover natural-language search and Dealership Mode. It translates these signals into predictive intelligence on demand, pricing, and inventory, then resells it to dealers through software products such as Dealer Data Insights and PriceVantage.

faq.q: What is the proof of scale for this strategy?
faq.a: In 2025, 60% of global paying dealers used Dealer Data Insights across their operations. The group had 34,409 paying dealers and annual revenue of 907.0 million dollars, up 14%. Management expects the monetized dealer products launched in 2025 to grow roughly 15x in 2026.

faq.q: What are CG Discover and Dealership Mode?
faq.a: CG Discover is a generative search where the shopper describes in natural language what they are looking for and receives a curated list. Dealership Mode triggers by geolocation when the shopper is on a dealer's lot and displays the lot inventory, AI-generated pros and cons, and a recommendation; it is announced as live for all consumer app users.

pattern: monetize a proprietary audience by reselling to suppliers a predictive intelligence fed by shoppers' behavioral signals
etape_parcours: consideration and purchase on the shopper side, after-sales and operations on the dealer side
objectif_business: Move CarGurus from a lead-generation marketplace to a day-to-day software partner for dealers, by reselling as subscriptions a predictive intelligence (demand, pricing, inventory) that the brand produces from the behavioral signals captured on its own shopping surfaces. The consumer AI experiences (Discover, Dealership Mode) attract and instrument the audience; that audience feeds the predictive platform sold to dealers.
description: CarGurus sells its audience twice. On the shopper side, the brand has deployed AI surfaces: CG Discover, a generative search where the user describes in natural language what they want (budget, use, options) and receives a curated list, and Dealership Mode, an app mode that triggers by geolocation when the shopper is on a dealer's lot and shows the lot inventory, AI-generated pros and cons, a recommendation described as unbiased, and an all-in price. Dealership Mode is announced as live for all consumer app users. These surfaces capture on average about 500 million first-party signals per day in 2025. CarGurus translates these signals into predictive intelligence on demand, pricing, and inventory, then resells it to dealers as software products. Dealer Data Insights, intelligence reports for dealers, were used by 60% of global paying dealers in 2025; in October 2025 the brand added PriceVantage, an action-oriented pricing product. At the group level, full-year 2025 revenue from continuing operations grew 14% for the second consecutive year, to 907.0 million dollars, with 34,409 paying dealers. Management expects the monetized dealer products launched in 2025 to grow roughly 15x in 2026. In parallel, CarGurus divested its wholesale business CarOffer to focus on the marketplace and the dealer software platform.
points_cles: CarGurus resells to dealers a predictive intelligence fed by its shoppers' signals.
CG Discover (natural-language search) and Dealership Mode instrument the audience: about 500 million first-party signals per day.
Dealer Data Insights used by 60% of global paying dealers in 2025; monetized products expected at +15x in 2026.
Proof A: full-year 2025 results, revenue 907M USD (+14%), 34,409 paying dealers, status confirmed.

niveau_preuve.justification: Figures from CarGurus' fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results, published February 19, 2026: official brand press release (revenue 907.0M USD, +14%, 34,409 paying dealers) and the earnings call transcript where the CEO details Dealer Data Insights adoption (60%), the volume of first-party signals (about 500 million per day), and the expected growth of monetized products (about 15x). Financial-results source, with a primary press release and a concordant transcript.

stack_technique.detail: Generative search experience where the shopper describes their priorities (budget, lifestyle, options) in natural language rather than through filters, and receives a curated list drawn from the selection of new and used vehicles. Presented as ramping up at the Q4 2025 earnings call.

Consumer app mode that, through geolocation, adapts the experience to the dealer where the shopper is located: lot inventory, vehicle details, AI-generated pros and cons, a recommendation presented as unbiased, and an all-in price estimate. Announced as live for all app users.
Intelligence reports built from shoppers' first-party signals, now central to the dealer workflow; used by 60% of global paying dealers in 2025.
First dedicated software product, launched in October 2025, that moves dealers from passive data consumption to action-oriented pricing decisions.

fonctionnement_operationnel.cadence: Real time on the consumer surfaces (CG Discover search, geolocated triggering of Dealership Mode). Continuous ingestion of first-party signals, about 500 million per day on average. Subscription-based consumption on the dealer side, with intelligence reports used in the daily workflow.
fonctionnement_operationnel.opere_par: CarGurus product and data teams for the AI surfaces and the predictive platform; paying dealers consume Dealer Data Insights and products such as PriceVantage in their operations.
fonctionnement_operationnel.signal_pilote: Shoppers' first-party behavioral signals (searches, comparisons, on-lot interactions via Dealership Mode). This is the raw material of the predictive intelligence being resold: if the volume or quality of these signals drops, the relevance of the demand, pricing, and inventory insights degrades, and with it the perceived value of the dealer products.

etapes.etape: Capture of intent on the shopper side
etapes.detail: The shopper describes their need in natural language in CG Discover, or enters Dealership Mode on a dealer's lot to see inventory, pros and cons, and a recommendation.
Each interaction feeds the data foundation; about 500 million signals are ingested per day on average in 2025.
The AI turns these signals into real-time insights on demand, pricing, and inventory.
The insights are packaged into software products (Dealer Data Insights, PriceVantage) integrated into the dealer workflow; 60% of global paying dealers used Dealer Data Insights in 2025.
The dealer adjusts pricing, inventory acquisition, and marketing based on the insights; the subscription to these products lifts revenue per dealer, tracked quarter after quarter.

prerequis_data: A high-volume proprietary audience that generates usable behavioral signals (searches, comparisons, interactions)
A capacity to ingest and structure these signals continuously, at large scale
An inventory and pricing reference on the supplier side to anchor the predictive insights
A product content base rich enough to feed a natural-language search
prerequis_orga: A two-sided marketplace where suppliers (here the dealers) already pay and can move up to software products
A product and data team able to operate both consumer AI surfaces and a subscription-sold analytics platform
A clear GDPR legal basis for reusing first-party signals and an AI transparency mechanism (AI Act) on the conversational surfaces
stack_possible: Generative natural-language search engine over the catalog
Recommendation and scoring on behavioral signals
Subscription software products delivered into the supplier workflow
replication.equipe: AI and data engineers (signal ingestion, predictive models, generative search) + a product team on the consumer surfaces + a product team on the dealer tools + a sales and success function to sell and drive adoption of the subscriptions + GDPR / AI Act compliance involved on an ongoing basis.

playbook.action: Map the first-party signals already captured by the shopping surfaces and assess which ones predict a decision on the supplier side (demand, price, inventory turnover).
playbook.livrable: Inventory of usable signals, ranked by predictive value.

playbook.action: Deploy one or two consumer AI surfaces (natural-language search, contextual mode) that enrich signal capture, with transparency about their AI nature.
playbook.livrable: AI surfaces in production that increase the volume and granularity of the signals.

playbook.action: Build a platform that translates these signals into real-time predictive insights, then package a first report for suppliers.
playbook.livrable: First intelligence product delivered to a panel of paying accounts.

playbook.action: Integrate the product into the supplier workflow (pricing, inventory) and measure adoption and revenue per account rather than usage alone.
playbook.livrable: Product adopted in operations, reading of incremental revenue per account.

playbook.action: Extend the range (pricing, inventory acquisition, marketing) and track the share of suppliers active on these products as a signal of scaling.
playbook.livrable: Suite of monetized products, adoption rate tracked over time.

replication.premiere_etape: Identify the densest behavioral signal in your audience (for example what shoppers compare before buying) and derive from it a first intelligence report useful to a supplier, tested with a small group of paying accounts before turning it into a product.

statut_vivant.note: Adoption and products presented as ramping up at the February 19, 2026 earnings call: Dealer Data Insights at 60% of paying dealers, CG Discover continuing to scale, Dealership Mode live for all app users. Management guides revenue growth of 10 to 13% in 2026 and a roughly 15x increase in the monetized products launched in 2025. Verification five months after the announcement.

transposable_ue.note: The model is already international: CarGurus had 8,360 paying dealers outside the United States at the end of 2025, and Dealer Data Insights are measured against the base of global paying dealers. The EU transposition rests on two points. First, the GDPR legal basis for the 500 million first-party signals captured each day on the shopper side, which feed the predictive intelligence platform sold to dealers. Second, AI Act transparency on the consumer-facing conversational surfaces (CG Discover natural-language search, AI-generated recommendations and pros and cons in Dealership Mode), where the user must know they are interacting with an AI and on what data the so-called unbiased recommendations rely.
